name: Khazarad, Mithril Way
desc1: This broad, flagstone-lined street heads through the heart of the
desc2: dwarven city. Meticulously clean, it is flanked by shops and intricate
desc3: stone carvings, and banners of gold hang from the walls. To the north
desc4: stands a plain building, a banner hanging over its door bearing a
desc5: picture of an axe, while a building to the south has a banner with a
desc6: suit of mail on it. The street continues to the east and west.
